jobs.name: card-colortone-goldenVeilGlow
jobs.prompt:
Regrade and retouch this photograph into the following preset look, applying the colour grade to the whole picture and the studio's signature skin finish to every visible area of skin: 'Golden Veil Glow' — TONE: a golden cinematic grade — marigold and amber golds glowing against deep black and steel-blue shadows, teal-leaning darks, rich contrast, a soft bloom on highlights. SKIN: soft glowing skin, warm but clear, no orange face. LIGHT: warm key light with deep falloff. MOOD: cinematic, glowing, dramatic. PALETTE (the grade's colour family, a reference for toning — NOT colours to paint onto the dress, the flowers or the walls): #D9A02A, #556782, #3A526E, #939296, #000707. Skin finish (the same on every preset): smooth, even, refined and luminous — blemishes, redness and unevenness gently cleared, fine natural pores and true facial shading kept, never plastic, waxy or a white mask; face, neck, arms and hands one matched tone.

TONE LOCK: this is the same photograph of the same person — keep the face, its proportions, expression, hair, body, pose, clothing, the background content and the framing exactly as they are; change ONLY the colour grade (white balance, tonal curve, contrast, saturation, colour palette) and the skin finish. Clothing, flowers, walls and furniture keep their own colours and patterns — an ivory dress stays ivory, white flowers stay white, a plain wall stays plain, only their shade shifts with the grade; nothing is repainted, recoloured, patterned or added.
REALISM: a photograph, not a render — true lens optics, natural fabric and hair texture, believable light, no painterly or CGI look.
AVOID: a different person or face, a changed pose, outfit or background, plastic or waxy skin, a white mask, colour spill from the background onto the skin, HDR crunch, heavy vignettes, added text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, a changed crop. NO STUDIO GEAR IN THE FRAME: no softboxes, light stands, umbrellas, reflectors, lamps, C-stands, backdrop stands or any photographic equipment may be drawn into the picture — light itself is welcome, the equipment that makes it never is.
TASK GUARD: return exactly one finished photograph and nothing else — no text, no captions, no UI, no watermark; keep the original aspect ratio and resolution feel.
